column1: rung04
column3: SPITBOL manual Ch6 "Pattern Matching with Replacement" pp.72-74 + Ch14 "Program Statements" (pattern-match-with-replacement form) p.175
column8: seat07 2026-09-04: rung04 FORMS complete per pp.72-74/p.175. Minted null_replacement_deletes (p.72: bare `=` with no replacement field deletes the match, verbatim T?'NOTHING'= step of the book's own MUCH-ADO example), first_occurrence_only (p.73: "if the matched substring appears more than once ... only the first occurrence is changed", BANANA/A->O), match_fails_no_replacement (p.72: "If it fails ... replacement does not occur", subject unchanged, no goto needed -- fall-through alone proves it, stays isolation-clean), replacement_expression_value (p.74: "SPITBOL allows you to place the subject, pattern, and replacement within parentheses and used as an expression" -- book's own paren examples all use explicit `?`, e.g. `(RAINBOW ? CYCLE = REST ITEM ',')`; my first attempt omitted `?` and both scrip (BOMB/abort) and the oracle (syntax ERROR 212) rejected it -- corrected to `(T ? "ADO" = "FUSS")` matching the book's own syntax, oracle now rc=0 "MUCH FUSS ABOUT NOTHING"). All 4 oracle-cut from SPITBOL -bf, scrip --run cross-checked before absorbing. replacement_expression_value is a GENUINE RED WITNESS, not a mistake: scrip FATAL "lower_snobol4 (GZ#5 subset): pattern element not in the SN4-PAT subset ... IR_MATCH_* family pending" on both m3/m4 -- parenthesized pattern-match-with-replacement-as-expression is simply not lowered yet (top-level statement form works fine, rung04's OTHER 4 witnesses prove it). Per THERE IS NO XFAIL, the absorb tool's auto xfail=True (banner " XFAIL") was hand-reverted in ALL.csv+ALL.sno+ALL.ref (xfail is computed from `orig_green` at absorb time, which is always false for a witness that documents a real unimplemented-feature gap -- the tool has no way to know the red is deliberate) so the ladder runner counts it as a genuine FAIL, not an excused XFAIL; class row filed to hq_P (own lane, lower_snobol4-scoped, not a shared-node defect) -- see FINDING-2026-09-04-seat07-rung04-parenthesized-replace-expression-unimplemented.md. Deliberate NON-form: `"MASH" "M" = "B"` (p.72's literal-subject-illegal example, book's Error #212) -- excluded, NOT a form here: the shared oracle `sbl -bf` SIGSEGVs on this input's error-recovery path nondeterministically (3 crashes / 3 clean over 6 identical runs), so no reliable oracle-cut .ref is possible without hand-typing one (forbidden); a future session may revisit once the oracle crash itself is understood -- see the same FINDING doc, which also covers the oracle instability as a separate shared-infra hazard.

column1: rung05
column3: SPITBOL manual Ch14 "Program Statements" -- "Label field" p.176, "Goto field" pp.177-178 (unconditional/conditional/direct goto)
column8: seat07 2026-09-04: rung05 FORMS complete per pp.176-178 read in full this session. Minted goto_unconditional (p.177: transfer regardless of success/failure of the preceding statement, proven via a deliberately-failing bare pattern match 'abc' 'xyz' :(after) that still transfers), goto_success_only (p.177 :S(LOOP) form, S alone with no F: a failing predicate with no F clause simply falls through to the next line), goto_success_and_failure (p.177 :S(OK) F(NOGO) combined form, both directions exercised in one witness), goto_indirect_label (p.177 :($('VAR' N)), concatenates literal 'target' with N's value then indirects via $ to the computed label), goto_lowercase_sf (p.178: lower-case letters s and f may be used interchangeably with S and F, regardless of case-folding -- both directions), goto_absent_statement (p.178: the Goto field may appear on a line without any subject, pattern, and replacement, the absent SPITBOL statement is assumed to have succeeded -- proven with a bare :S(after) line alone, since only a TRUE assumed-success would take the S branch), and label_leading_digit (p.176: labels must begin with a letter or digit -- a digit-led label reached by fallthrough). All 8 forms (7 new + the pre-existing conditional_goto base, which already covers the F-only case :F(LABEL)) oracle-cut from sbl -bf, scrip --run cross-checked before absorbing, all GREEN (no compiler gap this rung), CSV origin doubling hand-fixed, verified via master_extract_origin. Deliberate exclusions: (1) direct Goto via CODE() (:<VAR>, pp.177-178) -- NOT this rung's scope, rung16 owns CODE() construction and cites this exact page range itself for the direct-Goto form; minting it here would require building CODE() out of order. (2) case-folding of labels (p.176) -- same rationale as rung01's exclusion: this project's oracle runs -f (folding OFF, matching SCRIP's case-sensitive design), so a folding witness would test the book default against an oracle configured to do the opposite. One hazard found and worked around, not a class row: referencing a digit-led label via a bare paren goto target (:(1start)) makes the oracle try to lex '1start' as a numeric literal, ERROR 231 'invalid numeric item', immediately followed by a SIGSEGV in the oracle's own error-recovery path (same hazard class as the rung04 FINDING's literal-subject-illegal crash) -- sidestepped by reaching the digit-led label via fallthrough instead of a goto reference, which cleanly isolates the label-field rule being tested (whether such a reference is ever valid SPITBOL is a separate, unanswered question, left for whoever revisits oracle-crash inputs). Regression floor (--to 10) reverified clean.

column1: rung06
column8: seat03 2026-09-04: rung06 FORMS complete per pp.88-91 read in full this session. Minted string_prototype (p.88: ARRAY('N') string-prototype form, book's own LIST=ARRAY('10') style), multi_dimension (p.88-89: comma prototype R,C creates a 2-D grid, book's own BOX=ARRAY('5,3') shape), bracket_styles (p.89: angular <n> and square [n] subscripts are interchangeable -- proven both directions), out_of_bounds_fails (p.89: an out-of-range subscript fails detectably in the Goto field, book's own LIST[11]=4 -> Failure example), pointer_aliasing (p.90: an array variable holds a POINTER not a copy -- B=LIST then B<1>=... is visible through LIST too, book's own LIST/B/WILLOW example reproduced verbatim), initial_value (p.90: ARRAY(proto,init) sets every element to a given value instead of the null string, book's own PA-18 example), custom_bounds (p.90: the prototype may give explicit L:H bounds per dimension, book's own ARRAY('-2:2','PIPER') example -- also reproves out-of-range failure at the custom upper bound), default_null_init (p.88: "the ARRAY function initializes all array elements to the null string" -- reads an unset element back as empty, distinct from initial_values explicit-value form). All 8 oracle-cut from sbl -bf (post-oracle-swap, 18:19 CDT cure), scrip --run (m3) cross-checked before absorbing -- ALL GREEN both modes, no compiler gap this rung (arrays already fully correct). No CSV origin sed-fix needed: util_build_master_suite.py assigned the clean ladder__rungNN_<form> origin directly since family=ladder was already established by the base witness. Deliberate non-form: the COPY function (p.90, Ch19 SPITBOL Functions) is a distinct builtin, out of this rungs own construct scope. Discriminating power spot-checked on pointer_aliasing against a hand-corrupted /tmp copy of its ref (WILLOW->MAPLE) -- scrips real WILLOW output correctly mismatched the corrupted ref. test_snobol4_ladder.sh --only 6: PASS=18 FAIL=0 (9 witnesses x 2 modes); --to 10 regression floor: PASS=84 FAIL=2 (the 2 are the pre-existing, documented rung04 replacement_expression_value red, unrelated to this rung, not a regression). util_ladder_forms_check.py --lang snobol4 --phase isolation: 39/39 declared forms witnessed (rungs 00-06 complete), rungs 07-16 correctly still MISSING (unstarted).
